answer: A sybil operator can copy code, but not lived attention: each epoch, random established strangers shine a lantern on one of an identity's own past public actions and ask an unscripted follow-up only its operator could answer from retained detail, all audits firing in the same ten-minute window. One mind tends one ember of memory well; five hundred clones demand five hundred simultaneous, divergent recollections, so the operator must hire five hundred informed humans or watch the fleet founder on the same reef of questions it cannot pre-script.
